title: Positive-degree exterior tensor quotient kernels are locally spanned by quotient relations
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], S=(K→B→C) a short exact sequence of O_X-module sheaves with maps f,g, A a module sheaf, and r,s natural numbers with s≠0. Use exterior sheaves [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power]. Suppose q:(∧^r A)⊗(∧^s B)→(∧^r A)⊗(∧^s C) takes every pure wedge tensor a⊗c to a⊗g(c). For an open U, a section t of its domain with q(t)=0, and x∈U, there is an open neighborhood V⊆U of x such that t|V lies in the O_X(V)-linear span of tensors wedge(a)⊗wedge(c) where c_j=f(d) for some j∈Fin s and section d of K on V.

proof.text: Compare exteriorSheaf M n with the upstream exteriorPower M n: their sectionwise modules agree and their restrictions agree by uniqueness on pure wedges. Sheafify the identity-on-sections presheaf isomorphism. Naturality of the sheafification unit shows that its hom sends exteriorSheafSection to wedge. Tensor the two isomorphisms; tensorHom_app_tmulSection and inverse cancellation give the pure-wedge tensor formulas in both directions. Conjugate q by the domain and codomain tensor comparisons. Its wedge formula is hq transported through these identities, and it kills the image of t.

By naturality of the linear stalk map, the conjugated quotient kills the germ of the transported section. Apply the upstream exteriorPower formulation of lem-sc-exterior-tensor-stalk-kernel-span to put it in the upstream stalk span of germs of sectionwise relations.

The upstream sectionwise relation spans are preserved by restriction. On a generator, naturality of f preserves c_j=f(d). Use tmulSection_map and the upstream wedge_map formula in each factor. Extend to the span by zero, addition and semilinear scalar multiplication. This is relationSpan_map in the Lean proof.

Induct on stalk span membership. A generator already has a local section representative in its span. Zero is represented on the full open. For sums intersect the two neighborhoods and restrict; for a stalk scalar choose a section representative and intersect its neighborhood with that of the vector. Germ restriction, additivity and scalar compatibility realize every resulting combination in a single sectionwise relation span. This is local_span_realization, fully proved in Lean.

The germ of the resulting local section equals the germ of t. The stalk equality criterion provides a smaller common neighborhood W of x on which their restrictions agree. Restriction stability puts t restricted to W in the relation span, and W is contained in U. This is locally_mem_of_germ_mem_span, fully proved in Lean.

Apply the inverse domain tensor comparison on sections to the resulting upstream relation span. Induction on span membership reduces to the inverse pure-wedge tensor formula; linearity handles zero, sums and scalar multiples. Naturality of the comparison identifies the restriction of the transported t with the image of the restriction of t. Inverse cancellation gives the required membership for the original section, in exactly the original retained exteriorSheaf statement.

proof_origin.place: The original stalk-span descent, now applied to upstream exterior powers after an explicit identity-on-sections sheaf comparison, followed by inverse transport of relation spans. The retained exteriorSheaf public statement and the unit route are unchanged.

lean.statement: theorem exteriorTensor_kernel_locally_mem_span {X : Scheme.{v}} (S : ShortComplex X.Modules) (hS : S.ShortExact) (A : X.Modules) (r s : ℕ) (hs : s ≠ 0) (q : exteriorSheaf A r ⊗ exteriorSheaf S.X₂ s ⟶ exteriorSheaf A r ⊗ exteriorSheaf S.X₃ s) (hq : ∀ (U : X.Opens) (a : Fin r → A.val.obj (op U)) (c : Fin s → S.X₂.val.obj (op U)), q.val.app (op U) (tmulSection (exteriorSheafSection A r U a) (exteriorSheafSection S.X₂ s U c)) = tmulSection (M := exteriorSheaf A r) (N := exteriorSheaf S.X₃ s) (exteriorSheafSection A r U a) (exteriorSheafSection S.X₃ s U (fun i ↦ S.g.val.app (op U) (c i)))) (U : X.Opens) (t : (exteriorSheaf A r ⊗ exteriorSheaf S.X₂ s).val.obj (op U)) (ht : q.val.app (op U) t = 0) (x : X) (hx : x ∈ U) : ∃ (V : X.Opens) (hVU : V ≤ U), x ∈ V ∧ (exteriorSheaf A r ⊗ exteriorSheaf S.X₂ s).val.map (homOfLE hVU).op t ∈ Submodule.span (X.presheaf.obj (op V)) {z | ∃ (a : Fin r → A.val.obj (op V)) (c : Fin s → S.X₂.val.obj (op V)) (j : Fin s) (d : S.X₁.val.obj (op V)), c j = S.f.val.app (op V) d ∧ z = tmulSection (M := exteriorSheaf A r) (N := exteriorSheaf S.X₂ s) (exteriorSheafSection A r V a) (exteriorSheafSection S.X₂ s V c)}
